comparison.objective: Candidate installs rigid rack hardware; record threads a flexible shock cord through a spring cord lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Both coordinate spring actuation with insertion, but candidate depresses a rail tab while aligning paired rigid prongs, then supports, extends, and fastens a long rail; record holds a plunger open while feeding deformable cord through a passage.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks four prongs, spring extension, rack registration, screws, and self-support; record checks press-before-insertion history, one cord crossing, at least 4 cm on each side, spring grip, release, and 1 s hold.
comparison.reason: The actuation-plus-insertion pattern is shared, but rigid structural latching across two posts tests a materially different ability from deformable threading. Candidate needs numeric tab timing, prong pose, and spring-force criteria.
